name: n8n-nodes-compound
description: ParseRail for n8n: 41 finished-job AI operations in one node, documents to schema-valid JSON, extraction, triage, research, moderation, agent memory. One credit wallet, failed calls never burn credits.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp nodes/ParseRail/parserail.svg dist/nodes/ParseRail/ && cp credentials/parserail.svg dist/credentials/ && npm run icons:check
scripts.icons:check: test -s dist/nodes/ParseRail/parserail.svg && test -s dist/credentials/parserail.svg || (echo 'icon missing from dist, the node would publish iconless again (see the 2026-08-17 n8n manual review)' && exit 1)
